system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Your body has mass that is not strictly physical.

Three constant effects:

  • Ranged attacks against you roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 instead of the standard 2d10x10 attack pool (no Surge banking on dropped dice).

  • Manifestations and effects that require you to move in order to resolve (forced-charge compulsions, spatial-displacement triggers, ritual circles dependent on your motion) fail outright. The caster's expenditure is consumed.

  • Area-of-effect damage that allows a defense check is reduced by your Bulwark Initiation in points even on a failed check, before resistances apply.

Slow approach. A creature attempting to advance toward you across open ground (≥ 6 squares of unobstructed path) must succeed on a Soul defense check vs DC 15 + your Initiation tier. On a failure, the creature uses its entire turn to advance only its normal Move distance — it cannot Dash, charge, or take additional movement actions that turn.

system.requirements: Path of the Mountain, Bulwark Initiation 13
